content: Definition of optional interfaces requested by module Os API Function Header File Description Gpt_DisableNotification Gpt.h Disables the interrupt notification for a channel (relevant in normal mode). Gpt_EnableNotification Gpt.h Enables the interrupt notification for a channel (relevant in normal mode). Gpt_GetTimeElapsed Gpt.h Returns the time already elapsed. Gpt_StartTimer Gpt.h Starts a timer channel. Gpt_StopTimer Gpt.h Stops a timer channel.
